account_balances.notes: Solid month. Large Tarneit materials outlay ($4,387) hit cash but covered by new build payment. EV charger invoice ($3,960) issued but unpaid.
CASH FLOW SQUEEZE — Tarneit invoice ($8,580) not yet paid (materials already 4 weeks old). Commercial fitout ($8,250) issued on 30-day terms. Expenses exceed receipts this month.
Tarneit finally paid ($8,580). BAS payment ($5,340 inc catch-up) was a significant hit. Nexus Fitout still overdue.
Kowalski finally paid the apartment rewire ($6,490 - 43 days late). Nexus Fitout ($8,250) still outstanding. EV charger ($3,960) now 45+ days overdue.
Good revenue month but large Tarneit Stage 2 materials purchase ($3,124) and subcontractor ($1,320) reduced net cash. Nexus Fitout STILL unpaid — 90+ days.
Nexus Fitout finally paid ($8,250) after debt collection — 126 days late. BAS Q3 paid ($5,340). Williamstown heritage job ($8,470) outstanding but within 21-day terms.
